title: fix(app-shell): Setup refusals lead with one plain sentence, the code and detail behind More (objectui#13332)
body:
Closes #13332
Clause-②: no

## What the refusal path looked like on `origin/main` (measured)

The three Setup pages each draw a refusal in their own box. All three boxes are in `packages/app-shell/src/`, and no shared component sits under them:

| Page | Where it renders | Text it receives |
|---|---|---|
| Packages (publish, delete, ...) | `PackageDetailSheet`'s `msg` block in `PackagesPage.tsx` | `apiJson` → `readEnvelopeFailureText`: the server's `error.message` with ` (CODE)` appended |
| Positions (new, bad name) | the `error` banner in `ResourceEditPage.tsx` | `MetadataError.message`, the server's message verbatim |
| OAuth application register | the `action-param-refusal` box in `ActionParamDialog.tsx` | `ActionResult.error`, the server's message verbatim |

**The client does not add the code prefix. It is in the server's message.** `[writable_package_required] Cannot ...` is how `requireWritablePackage` in objectstack's `runtime` `domains/packages.ts` builds its sentence. `[body.redirect_uris.0] Invalid URL; [body.redirect_uris.0] URL must be parseable` is the validator's joined issue text. The Positions refusal (`refuseUngrammaticalMetaItemName`) is four sentences of grammar and retirement prose. The only thing the console adds is the trailing ` (CODE)` from `readEnvelopeFailureText`.

## What changed

The server message is still the source. The console now shows the message's first sentence and keeps the whole message, byte for byte, behind "More".

- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/refusalLead.ts` (new): `splitRefusal(text)` is the pure rule. It drops leading bracketed tokens that have no space inside (a code or a field path). The first sentence ends at `.`, `!` or `?` followed by whitespace or end of text, at a CJK full stop, at a `;` that opens another bracketed issue (`[path] msg; [path] msg`), or at a line break. A full stop after a lone letter (`e.g.`) does not end a sentence, and neither does a `;` inside a sentence. A trailing parenthesised UPPER_SNAKE code is left out of the lead. It returns `{ lead, full }`, where `full` is the whole trimmed message, or `null` when the lead already is the whole message.
- `packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.tsx` (new): renders the lead, then a "More"/"Less" `Collapsible` trigger (the repo's `@object-ui/components` Collapsible, as `ActionParamDialog`'s carry-over params use it). Inside is a selectable `pre` holding the full message and a copy button that writes the full message. When there is nothing to disclose it renders the bare text with no wrapper, so a one-sentence refusal has the same DOM as before.
- `ActionParamDialog.tsx`, `metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (error messages only; the ok row and the `details` list are unchanged), `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`: each box keeps its own colours, `role` and test id, and renders its text through `RefusalMessage`.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (all ten packs): new `refusalDetails.more`, `.less`, `.copy`, `.copied`.
- `.changeset/13332-refusal-plain-sentence-first.md`: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

Measured leads for the three card messages (pinned in the new test):
- Packages: `Cannot publish package 'com.acme.crm': it is read-only (provided by code or an installed app).`
- Positions: `"Sales/Rep" is not a legal metadata item name.`
- OAuth: `Invalid URL`

## Tests

- New `packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.test.tsx` covers the shared renderer. It runs `splitRefusal` on the three measured messages, plus a single sentence, a trailing code, `e.g.`, a CJK full stop, a line break, a semicolon inside a sentence and a code-only message. On the component it checks that the message is closed by default (no code or ADR prose on screen), that More shows the full text byte-equal, that copy writes the full text, and a control where a one-sentence message renders as bare text with no disclosure. Result: 1 file, 10 tests passed.
- Updated pins that asserted a multi-sentence refusal's whole text on screen. Each one now opens More and asserts the same whole text, and nothing a pin checked is dropped: `ActionParamDialog.refusalKeepsInput-13161` (it now also pins the OAuth lead `Invalid URL`), `useConsoleActionRuntime.paramRefusal-13161`, `PackagesPage.confirmFlows-11784`, `PackagesPage.publishRefusal-11922` (its `publishAndRead` helper opens More when there is one), `PackagesPage.walledCatalogRefusal-7611` (the Delete case), `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188` and `ResourceEditPage.resetPackage-12335`.
- Every test whose file name names one of the three call sites: 65 files. Before the pin updates, 9 files and 16 tests were red, all of them the whole-text assertions above. After: all green.
- Indirect consumers (tests that mount the three through `ResourceRouter`, `MetadataDetailDrawer`, `MetadataTypeActions`, `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`, `ObjectView`, Studio and `AppContent`, filtered to the ones that assert a refusal): 107 files, 975 tests passed.
- `packages/i18n/` and `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: 85 files passed (1351 passed, 13 skipped).
- Type-check: `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n` passed, 31/31 tasks (app-shell ran `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`).
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (4 keys added, 0 en values changed) and `check:i18n-dead-keys` all exit 0. `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new. Changeset presence and no-major checks are green. Lint on the touched files shows 0 errors and no warnings in the new files.
- Ablation, one run: `splitRefusal`'s return was replaced with `return { lead: full, full: null };` (whole text again) using `ablation-replace`, and the mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed). `RefusalMessage.test.tsx` and `ActionParamDialog.refusalKeepsInput-13161` went red: 10 failed, 9 passed. The single-sentence and code-only controls stayed green. Restore was verified: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Runs are on `c34aa0e1f`.

## Acceptance notes

- Judgment call: the lead is always the first sentence. A short two-sentence plain refusal such as `User already exists. Use another email.` now leads with `User already exists.` and puts the second sentence behind More. The card asks for one plain sentence first, and a length threshold would be a second rule nobody declared.
- Judgment call: one shared component inside `packages/app-shell/src/` is the seam. The three boxes keep their own styling, so the diff at each site is one line.
- Not changed: the action runner's error toast (`toastHandler` in `useConsoleActionRuntime`) still shows a refusal's whole text. A refused param-dialog run (OAuth register) toasts as it did before, beside the dialog box that now leads with the sentence. The toast path is objectui#13340's surface and is left alone here.
- Not measured: the `i18n-locales` eager-chunk byte budget (`pnpm check:eager-closure` needs a build). Four short keys were added per pack, and CI reads the budget.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
